Name: The Living Valley - Downhill Patch and New NPCs
Author: mariachaaan
Description:
[b][size=5]Expanded Lore: The Secrets of Downhill
[/size][/b]
Downhill is a forgotten, isolated neighborhood on a steep hill between the Backwoods and the Mountain.

[b]The Rockslide's Origin:[/b] The local church was partially destroyed by a rockslide four years ago. It is rumored that this rockslide wasn't just a natural disaster, but the result of the deep, unstable mining tunnels that made the industry too dangerous to continue

[b]The Family Rift:[/b] Miss Julia's daughter stopped visiting her due to "family issues". This rift likely stems from the death of Julia's late husband, Mr. Antonio. As a miner in a dangerous, declining industry, his passing may have caused a bitter argument over whether the family should abandon the isolated neighborhood.

[b]The Priest's Past:[/b] Father Anderson arrived in the valley at age 40 and is known for being respectful of all lifestyles, yet he "has his secrets". Perhaps he fled a complicated past in Zuzu City, seeking refuge in the small outbuilding behind the church that miraculously survived the rockslide


[b][size=5]NEW NPCS[/size][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/edTDPzR.gif[/img]

[b][size=4]Chloe - The Scrap Mechanic & Tinkerer
[/size][/b]
Chloe is uniquely tied to Arthur, the last remaining coal miner in Downhill. She is the only person patient enough to constantly fix his old, broken-down truck

[b]Personality:[/b] Spunky, grease-smudged, and relentlessly optimistic. She serves as a stark contrast to the aging, quiet atmosphere of the neighborhood. She matches Arthur's loud, cheerful energy but brings a much-needed youthful spark to the forgotten area


[img]https://i.imgur.com/r0hpyu1.gif[/img]

[b][size=4] Beckett - The Rugged Geologist
[/size][/b]
Beckett works closely with Arthur, the 52-year-old miner who refuses to quit. While Arthur mines the remaining coal and copper, Beckett is a university-educated geologist who believes there are undiscovered, highly valuable minerals deep beneath Downhill. He spends his days mapping the dangerous, old tunnels.

[b]Personality:[/b] Adventurous, rugged, and endlessly patient (a trait required to deal with the loud and easily frustrated Arthur)


[img]https://i.imgur.com/aynDAdh.png[/img]

[b][size=4]Clara - The Prodigal Daughter
[/size][/b]
Clara is Miss Julia’s estranged daughter who stopped visiting due to family issues. Clara left the Valley in her early twenties, wanting to escape the danger of the declining mining industry that employed her late father, Mr. Antonio. After years away, she has quietly returned to Pelican Town. Knowing that her 84-year-old mother struggles with knee problems and rarely leaves the house, Clara wants to make amends but is too stubborn to make the first move.

[b]Personality:[/b] Guarded, independent, but deeply caring. Despite the estrangement, she inherited her mother’s warm heart and her love for taking care of small gardens.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ih67nTP.png[/img]

[b][size=4]Elias - The Architectural Historian[/size]
[/b]
Elias is a restoration architect working closely with Father Anderson to rebuild the ruined church. Drawn by Downhill's nostalgic vibe and rich history, Elias moved to the Valley to assess the damage from the rockslide that destroyed the sanctuary four years ago. Because Father Anderson lives in the surviving outbuilding, Elias spends a lot of time there and is slowly uncovering the "secrets" the cheerful priest is hiding.

[b]Personality:[/b] Analytical, passionate, and a bit of a workaholic. He finds the isolation of the steep neighborhood peaceful rather than lonely

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TA7YNcc.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/iFzcqt6.gif[/img]
